segments.en: The Withdrawal of Wisdom in Exile

segments.he: מתעלה ,והעולם עצמו מתעלה עמו׳, וכו׳. . 29שעיקר כוונת הנהגת השכינה היא — לקדש את האדם ואת העולם. . 30עי׳ במכתבי רמח׳׳ל בסוף הספר,
segments.en: And it came to pass — and the word וַיְהִי (vay'hi) connotes grief [Megillah 10b] — when G-d exiled us from the House of His holiness and His splendour: "For He crushed us in a place of jackals and covered us over with the shadow of death" [Tehillim 44:20], "In darkened places He has made me dwell, like those forever dead" [Eichah 3:6] — and the wisdom began to withdraw from Yisrael, as the darkness steadily intensified — because of the evil that increased day by day. And Yisrael went sinking ever deeper into this great darkness through all the generations — and found themselves remote from the holy Shechinah. Not remote by virtue of themselves — for in any event, Yisrael are never altered from their holiness for all eternity — and it is said of them: "the children of Israel, the people close to Him" [Tehillim 148:14]. Rather, the darkness darkens around them, and they are unable to gaze upon the light — even though it is near to them — and therefore they are called remote from it. But G-d, in His mercy, left a remnant for us — namely, the plain meaning of Torah, which was given to us as an inheritance never to depart from our mouths forever. And through this we remain close to Him always — if not in an open manner, then at least in the mode of the hiding of the face. And of this it is said: "And I said: I will hide My face from them; I will see what their end will be" [Devarim 32:20] — even though I hide — I will see. But it is a great affliction for the souls, which thirst and yearn for light — to bask in the light of life in closeness to the Blessed One and to stand in His secret — for it is for this purpose that they were created, that they should be lacking in this light.20 As it is stated in the Raaya Mehemna, Parashas Pinchas [249b]: "R' Moshe said: these words are sealed, and they must be opened for the companions — for whoever seals from them the hidden treasures of Torah causes them anguish."21

segments.he: דרוש הזה כולו ,כי אלף שנים אלו חיה — לא יתחיל אפילו בהתחלת הקדמה אחת״ עכ״ל(שער מאמרי רז״ל ,מד״ר פרשה מג)0נ*. ואמנה בהשאר החכמה כך ערומה ,דברים סתומים בלי הבנה ,נולד מזה רעה אחרת — שחכמים גדולים עזבוה בקרן זוית ,כי מטבע החכמים לבקש הבנה מיושבת ,ולדעת הדברים בעמקם ,ולא להתרצות במלין בעלמא .ובראותם שאין בדברים האלה מה שימלא תאותם ,אמרו למה נבלה זמננו במה שאי אפשר לנו להשיג .ואחרים הרעו יותר ,כי לא די שמאסו בה ,אלא שדברו עליה סרה ,בחשוב אותה כפתיות שקבלו עליהם בני אדם להתקע בדברים גסים ובלתי מתקבלים .ועוד הגיעו לכפור בעיקריה ,ולשלול היות הזהר הקדוש מחובר מהרשב״י זלה״ה וחבריו .וכל זה מהיות דברי החכמה זרים בעיניהם ,עד שאין ראוי להם להתיחס אל איתנים מוסדי ארץ — התנאים זללה״ה .אך האמת הוא, שהחכמה סתומה הרבה ,ועל זה נאמר :מפי סופרים ולא מפי ספרים ,כי הרח״ו ז״ל כיוון להסתיר דבריו בספר ,והשאיר הסוד חתום באוצרותיו, לגלותו לאשר הגון בעיניו .ובהבנת הלומדים רק מן הספר — חסרו הסופרים' 3מן העולם ,עד שנמצאת החכמה כיום הזה מבולבלת ביד לומדיה ,ומעטים המה היורדים לעמקם של דברים ,ויופי החכמה אינם רואים כלל. על כן אמרתי אני אל לבי :״עת לעשות לה׳״ (תהלים קיט ,קכו), ולית דין צריך בוש והכלם ,לאמר :מי אנכי כי אבא עד הלום ,לדבר דבר לפני גדולים וטובים ממני ,את אשר כבר ” ...הגדולים אשר מעולם אנשי השם ,כי לכל זמן ועת לכל חפץ ,וקרא כתיב :״ואדברה בעדותיך נגד מלכים ולא אבוש״(תהלים קיט ,מו) ,כי תורה היא וללמוד אנו צריכים, לעשות נחת רות ליוצרנו .וכתר תורה מונח ועומד ,כל הרוצה לזכות בה יבא ויזכה .ולא מזער היא ליאור באור החיים ,אלין רזין דאורייתא, שהם לבושין נהירין של השכינה ,ובהיכלו כולו אומר כבוד .ולא עוד, אלא שכל דקדוקיה ופרטותיה של תורה עומדים עליה ,והדברים הנראים קלים לעינים ,אשר לא אורו באור הגדול הזה — כל סייגותיהם של פרק מא. .* 30לפי הגירסה שנדפסה כספר חסד לאברהם ,דפוס אמסטרדם. . 31־החכמים. .32בכ׳׳י מלה מטושטשת.
segments.en: And of this King David would say: "My soul thirsts for You, my flesh yearns for You, in a land of dryness and exhaustion without water — as in the Sanctuary I have beheld You" [Tehillim 63:2]. For his longing was this — to delight in the pleasure of knowing His glory, blessed be He, in which knowing the soul is slaked and satisfied from the light of the holy Shechinah. And above the passage I cited, the Raaya Mehemna itself states: "He rose a second time and said: Masters of Mishnah — your souls, spirits, and breaths — awaken now all of you, and banish sleep from yourselves — for it is truly mishnah — the way of the plain meaning of this world. And I aroused you only with the supernal secrets of the World to Come, in which you [behold]: 'Behold, He neither slumbers nor sleeps'"22 [Zohar Vol. III, 244b].

segments.he:
הקדמה למאמו הויכוח

ר מ ו " 1ל חכמים וגזירותיהם וחומרותיהם שבני אדם דשים בעקבם .הנה רק בחכמה הזאת יודעים ונראים עד היכן הדברים מגיעים ,ואיך כולם עומדים ברום עולם. 13 על כן בחרתי לסדר המאמר הזח בסדר מתוקן ונאה ,לגלות בו יופי החכמה הגדולה הזאת לעיני בני ישראל .ובהיות כי הפילוסופיה והמחקר היא הנעשית צרה תמיד לחכמה הגדולה הזאת ,שפחה חצופה החושבת לרשת גבירתה ,היא נגע צרעת אשר פשטה ממש בעוונותינו הרבים בישראל ,היתה להם למכשול און ,להתפש בה אנשים חכמים ואוהבי הדעת .כי כאשר שמח בפוך עיניה והיא מתחפשת בבגדים יפים למראה, וכי תאוה הם לעינים ,כלם דברים מיושבים לכאורה ,ומתקבלים אל השכל במופתים חותכים וטעמים מובחרים ,שקר החן והבל היופי, הראתה לעיניהם שחכמה האמיתית לל^ה ולא כלום .בהיותה מצח שמורה רק לבעליה ,שחורה מבחוץ ונאוה מבפנים ,ונתקיים בה המקרא ״אל תראוני שאני שחרחורת״(שיר השירים א ,ו) .על כן סידרתי המאמר הזה בדרך ויכוח חוקר ומקובל ,בזח יבואו בתוך הויכוח כל מח שמנגדים החוקרים האלה על החכמה הקדושח הזאת ,ותשובותיהם בצדם בדברי המקובל המשיב על תוכחתו. והנה הלכתי בסדר הויכוח מן הקודם אל הנמשך לו ,כאשר יאות לשכל ההולך ומתישב על הדברים כסדר ,וחלקתיו לח׳ ויכוחים :הא׳ — בו יבואו כל התמיהות הגדולות הנופלות לכאורה על כללות החכמה על פי דברי המקובלים זללה״ה ,וישובם ,הכל באר היטב .הב׳ — בו יתבאר כל האילן של הספירות והפרצופים והעולמות ,מן המדריגח הראשונה עד האחרונה ,דהיינו מתחלת אדם קדמון עד סוף כל העולמות, המסור לנו מן האר״י זלה״ה . 34הג׳ — בו יתבאר כוונת כל האילן הזח בכל ענפיו בקיצור נמרץ ,מח שצריך לעמוד על תוכן כוונת החכמה בכל דרושיה . 35הד׳ -בו יתבארו כל עניני האילן בארוכה ,ובכל ענין יבחנו בו כל ההבחנות שצריך להבחין בו . 34הה׳ — הוא סדר למוד ללמד למי .33עי׳ להלן בסי׳ קב — כל דקדוקי
segments.en: And this is the matter of "and a deep sleep fell upon Avram, and behold — a dark dread" [Bereishis 15:12] — which refers to the exiles, for in exile the condition of Israel is like that of a sleeping man. And the secret of the sleep was explained there in the Raaya Mehemna itself, above: "When night comes, the gates of Gehinnom open, for it is bitter, and its smokes spread and rise to the brain, etc." [ibid. 222a]. And that is to say: the sleep is drawn from the dominion of the smokes of Gehinnom — which seal over the souls and do not allow them to clothe themselves in the supernal light as would be fitting for them. For the soul is nothing other than an intellect made to comprehend the supernal light of the glory for which it was created. And note: man is composed of soul and body, and Torah is composed of plain meaning and secret. And one who engages and labours in the secrets of Torah — not only does light and abundance come to his soul from the level appropriate for the soul, but to his body as well from that very level. And this is the great praise of the masters of Kabbalah — that they all sanctify themselves in supernal sanctity — as mentioned in many places in the Zohar and the Tikkunim. But one who engages only in the plain meaning — not even to his soul does there come anything more than the abundance that is appropriate for the body, and his soul is found greatly deficient.

segments.he: מצוות וגזירות רז׳׳ל מוסברים לעומקם
segments.en: And as the exile has lengthened, so the darkness has intensified upon the souls, and this knowledge has gone steadily withdrawing from Yisrael. And one evil causes many evils — for just as the knowledge was lacking among Yisrael, so too those who pursued it diminished — and as the Sages of blessed memory said: "a garment is precious to its owner"23 [Shabbos 10b] — and this added deficiency upon deficiency of knowledge. And through our many sins the remoteness increases day by day. And as the darkness and gloom multiplied, the Sitra Achra24 has already built fortresses around this matter — and poured out many siege-ramps through many events that occurred in the world, and many weak arguments and contentions — to distance the wise from this learning, in order to keep all of Yisrael in the deep slumber of their exile, heavier than the weight of a stone and the burden of sand [see Mishlei 27:3].

segments.en: R' Shimon bar Yochai's Cry — The Superiority of the Path of Kabbalah

segments.he: וזקדמח למאמר וזמכייז
segments.en: And R' Shimon bar Yochai, the Holy One of Israel, cries out like a crane from every corner and side in the Zohar and the Tikkunim — that there is no rectification for the holy Shechinah except through the mysteries of Torah. And when there is no Kabbalah, it is said [Yeshayahu 19:5]: "and the river shall be dried up and parched" [see Tikkunay Zohar 107a] — "Then they shall call upon me and I shall not answer, etc." [Mishlei 1:28]. And the Raaya Mehemna, Parashas Emor, states: "But of the Rabbis — woe to those who eat the straw of Torah and do not know the secrets of Torah, only the light and stringent matters of Torah" [see Zohar Vol. III, 275b].

segments.he:
ימח״ל

שמתחיל בחכמה ” .ומי שירצח להתלמד בסדר נכון ,הנח יצטרך להתחיל מן הויכוח חזח חאחרון יי ,ואחר ילך אל הויכוח חשני* , ,ואח״כ אל השלישי ,ואח״כ אל הרביעי ,כי אני הלכתי על פי סדר הויכוח ,כדי ללכת על פי דרך המאמר שרציתי בו.40 ואתח קורא נעים ,דע ,pmכי דברי חכמת האמת או שהם מובנים בתכלית ההבנח ,עד שנראים ברורים לעין כשמש הזאת ,או שאינם מובנים כלל ,והם זרים בתכלית הזרות .כי מי שילד בחם בדרך חישרח — ימצאם מבוררים כשמלח ,כולם דברים מוכרחים ,דבר דבור על אפניו ,בלא שום פקפוק כלל ועיקר .ומי שישגח ,ותתחלף לו הדרך האמיתית — יהיו לעיניו כהרים גבוהים אשר אין כח לעלות אליהם כלל. כלל .וכן אמרו בזחר פ׳ פנ חס(תג ע״ב) :״אמר רעיא מהימנא — אלין מלין כמח סתימין אמן למאן דלא ידע בהו ,וגליין למאן דידע בהו״ .וכמו שחלומד אותם בלי חחבנח חראויח ,נראים לו כתפל מבלי מלח ,כך חלומד אותם בהבנתם — ימצא בחם חכמח עמוקה ,אשר כל שאר החכמות יחשבו לפניו כאין וכאפס .ויתלחט לבבו באחבח אל חשכינח חקדושח ,להתאוות בכל דרכיו ,לחיות רק מתחסד עם קונו ,ולעשות נחת רוח ליוצרו" .אשרי העם שככח לו אשרי העם,שח׳ אלחיר׳(תחלים קמד,
segments.en: And now let me show you one great superiority of the path of Kabbalah over the path of plain meaning. According to the plain meaning — all the things of this world are physical matters and deficiencies of man in his being dust from the earth. And one who wishes to be pious can only do so by separating himself from pleasures as much as possible, and enjoying only what is indispensable to his survival. And even in this he should be careful with all the detailed stringencies applicable to that matter — then he will be a pious person who has departed from evil. And that deed will remain good — since it was only necessary for survival. And it will also be found to be service to Hashem — since he does it in order to live and serve his Creator. But even so, the act itself will not cease to be a human deficiency — and if it were possible to do without it, it would have been better.

segments.he: טו) .אבל אימח ויראח רתת וזיע חם יחיו לך למלבוש ,ולא יסורו ממך.
segments.en: Kabbalah surpasses this — for according to its path the very deeds themselves return to being good and supernal rectifications.25 This is because the supernal will arranged it thus — that the things of this world are sanctified through man's using them for his needs and enjoyment. For the matters of Heaven are all holy, and in the end the entire world will be holy — the earth and all that is in it, just like the heavens and all that is in them. And all of this was entrusted into the hand of man — and this is the secret of: "The heavens are the heavens of Hashem, but the earth He gave to the sons of man" [Tehillim 115:16] — for the heavens He established in all their perfection, but the earth He gave to human beings that they should rectify it. For the power was given to man to draw down the power of the Shechinah and its light below through his soul — and all the things of the world were given for his use, so that through this they too are rectified, and the power of holiness he drew down spreads upon them as well. But he must know the ways of how to use the world — so that that use becomes a rectification and not a corruption, G-d forbid. For he must separate from pleasures on weekdays — since excessive such use does not rectify but corrupts — because of the paths and statutes the supernal will has already inscribed for this. And likewise he must be careful with all the stringencies and detailed particulars — for without this the Sitra Achra becomes mingled in, G-d forbid, and he is found corrupting rather than rectifying — as is explained in its place.26 For this matter requires a broad explanation, and this is not its place. But when the deed is done in the proper manner — it itself becomes a rectification. And this is a matter encompassing all the things of the world and of nature. And he must know the particulars of things — in order to proceed entirely in this way — and then his deeds will make him like a true angel of Hashem of hosts.

segments.en: It is thus found that Chochmas HaEmes explains the matter of holiness and the resting of G-d, blessed be He, upon His creatures, and His cleaving to them. And this is the matter of "the earth is full of Your acquisitions" [Tehillim 104:24] that I mentioned above.27 For the essence of what the Holy One Blessed be He desires in His world is this — that all the matters of the world be true rectifications and matters of holiness. And the root of all that was, is, and will be in the world is this: the desire of the supernal will to draw near to Himself the human being — to rest upon him and cleave to him. And He desired specifically man — since he is more beloved to Him — for man is the one who renders true service: who fights with the evil inclination and gives glory to Hashem, blessed be He, more than all other created beings. For since these others lack an evil inclination, the glory of G-d does not rise from their service as it rises from the service of man — who must withstand all the difficult battles waged by his inclination against him — all for the sake of serving the Omnipresent and glorifying His Name, and all through his free choice — which is not the case for all other created beings who have no free choice. It is thus found that the supernal will brought this being into existence, gave him this service — and correspondingly cherishes and loves him greatly. Therefore He established great ways and wondrous statutes for this person — to rectify himself and his place, which is this world.28 And the Shechinah governs with this person and all that depends on him with a great and very deep governance — and its intention is to sanctify him, and to sanctify all that depends on him, and to remove the obstacle — which is the evil that had been weighing upon him, and which caused him all the great labour and heaviness of battle. And the totality of all these paths and statutes is this Chochmas HaEmes. And you can see that this matter is exceedingly honourable — sufficient to say that it is the matter of the spreading of His holiness, blessed be His Name, throughout His world, and His cleaving with His creatures. Can there be anything more honourable and awesome than this? Moreover, upon this depends all of governance — as we said above.29

segments.en: But as the exile has lengthened and darkness fell upon Yisrael — this knowledge became much lost from them; and in these our latter generations, only the smallest remnant of it has remained. For this wisdom in the earlier generations was exceedingly great. And you see the words of the holy Zohar — how they stand at the very heights of the world, explaining the mysteries of the King literally on every single letter — so many very deep secrets — making known great wisdom in the secret of His counsel, blessed be His Name. But in our times, nothing remains but as a memory of the wisdom that existed in previous generations. And had it not been that the holy Ari z"l opened for us the gates of light through his holy spirit — the wisdom would already have been entirely forgotten by us. And even now, after the righteous pillar of the world ascended to his rest, and the wisdom has been hidden generation after generation, until his words and matters have become as words of a sealed book — with many difficulties and apparent contradictions in the words of R' Chaim Vital z"l.

segments.en: And what is harder still: the understanding of things in general is very sealed and closed30 — for he z"l sealed his words greatly, and did not wish to explain in writing. And from this arose — that readers of his words took them according to their plain surface reading, and this is no understanding at all. For what we have are merely the names of matters to be memorised as a key to books. For when we know there are so-and-so many Sefiros, and so-and-so many Partzufim, and so-and-so many worlds, and that they clothe themselves one within the other, and that there are so-and-so many ascents and descents — but we do not know the intention in all these things — this turns out to be no knowledge at all, merely memorised rote-learning without any analytical understanding. And R' Chaim Vital himself warned of this explicitly in his commentary on the discourse of the Steps — and said: "Let not the reader of this commentary think that he can understand even so much as a surface skimming of this discourse — for were he to live a thousand years, he would not even begin one single introduction." [Sha'ar Ma'amarei Razal, Midrash Rabbah §43]30*

segments.he: נכתב עבור המתחילים ללמוד את חכמת
segments.en: But while the wisdom remains so bare — sealed words without understanding — another evil arose from this: that great sages abandoned it to a corner. For it is the nature of sages to seek settled understanding, and to know things in their depth, and not to be satisfied with mere words. And seeing that these things could not satisfy their intellectual appetite, they said: why should we spend our time on what we cannot attain? And others did worse — for not only did they spurn it, but they spoke against it — imagining it to be foolishness that people had taken upon themselves. And some even went so far as to deny its fundamentals and to deny that the holy Zohar was composed by Rashbi z"l and his companions. And all of this arose from the fact that the words of the wisdom were foreign to them — until they did not seem fitting to be attributed to the mighty pillars of the world — the Tannaim z"l. But the truth is: the wisdom is very sealed — and of this it is said: "from the mouths of scribes and not from the mouths of books" — for R' Chaim Vital z"l intended to seal his words in the book, and left the secret sealed in his treasuries — to reveal it to whoever was fitting in his eyes. And with the readers learning only from the book — the scribes31 were lost from the world, until the wisdom today is found confused in the hands of those who study it, and few are those who descend to the depth of things.

segments.en: Therefore I said to myself: "It is time to act for Hashem" [Tehillim 119:126] — and there is no one who needs to be ashamed and embarrassed, saying: who am I that I should come thus — to speak before those greater and better than myself. For Torah it is, and we must learn — to give satisfaction to our Creator. And the crown of Torah stands and awaits — whoever wishes to merit it may come and merit. And it is no small thing — to be illuminated by the light of life: these mysteries of Torah, which are the luminous garments of the Shechinah, and in His palace everyone declares glory. And moreover — all the detailed particulars of Torah stand upon this — and those things that appear light to the eyes, which have not been illuminated by this great light — all the fences of the Sages and their decrees and their stringencies that people trample underfoot: only in this wisdom are they known and seen — how far-reaching they are and how they all stand at the very heights of the world.33

segments.en: Therefore I chose to arrange this treatise in a proper and beautiful order — to reveal in it the beauty of this great wisdom to the eyes of the children of Israel. And since philosophy and investigation has always been the adversary of this great wisdom — the insolent maidservant who imagines she will inherit her mistress — it is a plague of leprosy that has, through our many sins, truly spread in Israel, and has become a stumbling block for them — ensnaring men of wisdom and love of knowledge. For when she adorns herself with cosmetics and disguises herself in beautiful clothing pleasing to the eye — and all appears to be well-reasoned, and accepted by the intellect with decisive proofs and select arguments — the grace is false and the beauty is vain — she showed to their eyes that the true wisdom is as nothing. While it is reserved for its true owners — dark on the outside and beautiful within — and of it the verse is fulfilled: "Do not look at me for I am dark" [Shir HaShirim 1:6]. Therefore I arranged this treatise in the form of a debate between a Philosopher and a Kabbalist — into which debate enter all the objections that these philosophers raise against this holy wisdom — and their refutations alongside them in the words of the Kabbalist who responds to his challenge.

segments.he: הויכוח הראשק יש ללמוד אחד סיום
segments.en: And I proceeded in the order of the debate from the prior to what follows from it — as befits an intellect that progressively settles upon things in order — and I divided it into five discourses: the First — in it enter all the great astonishments that apparently fall upon the totality of the wisdom from the words of the Kabbalists z"l, and their resolution — all explained thoroughly. The Second — in it is explained the entire Tree of the Sefiros and Partzufim and Worlds — from the first level to the last: namely from the beginning of Adam Kadmon until the end of all the worlds — as transmitted to us from the Ari z"l.34 The Third — in it is explained the intention of this entire Tree in all its branches in sharp conciseness — what is needed to stand upon the content of the intention of the wisdom in all its discourses.35 The Fourth — in it are explained all the matters of the Tree at length — and in each matter all the distinctions that need to be distinguished within it.36 The Fifth — it is a study order for teaching one who is beginning in the wisdom.37 And whoever wishes to study in the correct order will need to begin from this last discourse,38 and then go to the Second Discourse,39 and then to the Third, and then to the Fourth — for I proceeded according to the order of the debate, in order to follow the approach of the treatise I desired in it.40

segments.he: ארבעה החלקים האחרים. .40להגן על חכמת האמת בפני הטוענים עליה והטועים בה.
segments.en: And you, pleasant reader — know this well: the words of Chochmas HaEmes are either understood in the ultimate understanding — until they appear as clear as the sun itself — or they are not understood at all, and are foreign in the extreme. For one who enters them on the straight path — will find them as clear as a garment, all things logically necessary, each matter properly in its place, without any doubt whatsoever. But one who errs and takes a different path from the true one — they will appear to him as high mountains that there is no power to ascend. And so it is said in the Zohar, Parashas Pinchas [303b]: "Said the Faithful Shepherd — these words, how sealed they are to one who does not know them, and how revealed to one who does know them." And just as one who studies them without the proper understanding finds them tasteless food without salt — so one who studies them with understanding will find in them a deep wisdom, before which all other wisdoms are as nothing and emptiness. And his heart will be aflame with love for the holy Shechinah — to desire in all his ways to be only devoted to his Creator, and to give satisfaction to his Maker. "Fortunate is the people for whom this is so — fortunate is the people whose G-d is Hashem" [Tehillim 144:15]. But awe and fear, trembling and shaking shall be your garment — and shall not depart from you. With clear thought, bring these matters to their proper rectitude in your heart — "and Hashem will give wisdom — from His mouth, knowledge and understanding" [based on Mishlei 2:6]. "But it is the spirit that is in man, and the breath of the Almighty that gives understanding" [Iyov 32:8].
